rationale: All runs are feasible with wide headroom, so only T_eff matters. At the 4.5 ns floor AREA 3 is aim-limited, not wall-limited: in every cap213 run signoff slack equals the placement-stage setup margin plus 0.12-0.14 ns (margin 0.2->0.4 gave +0.21 ns), and period, margins and RC pessimism are now at their limits (stock and orfs runs end at or below their margins). Further gains need a larger estimate-to-signoff gap, which looked larger when the resizer did more work (41% vs 55% density: 0.143 vs 0.129; ocs_blitter without ABC buffering/sizing: 0.139). Setting 1: round-2 best at util 20 (31% density). Setting 2: setting 1 without ABC buffering/sizing, isolating each factor in turn.
